//: The cookbooks' runnable scripts (`*/scripts/**`), which the root tsconfig deliberately excludes. They are node code — they read the filesystem and the environment — while `*/infra/**` is declarative resource code that must stay node-free, so the two cannot share one `types` setting. Both run under `npm run typecheck`. A consumer project needs nothing like this: `cargo-ai cdk init` already covers `scripts/**/*.ts` with node types from its root tsconfig.
